title: All Video Player - MNet Player
summary: Video player for your local files, IPTV playlists and HLS/MPD live streams.
description:
MNet Player is a fast, all-in-one HD video player for Android — an all-format video player that plays the videos already stored on your device, browses them by folder, and plays IPTV playlists and HLS/MPD live stream links, all in one lightweight app.

⭐️ Key Features:
▶️ Local Video Player
● Browse your entire video library by folder
● Continue Watching — resume exactly where you left off
● Recently Added, favorites, search and sorting
● Plays MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, WEBM, TS, FLV and more — a true all-format video player
● Hardware-accelerated, smooth 4K video playback

🔒 Private Folder:
● Hide videos behind a PIN or fingerprint
● Screenshots blocked and hidden from the Recents screen
● Auto-locks as soon as you leave the app

🎵 Music Player:
● Play the audio stored on your device
● Background playback with mini player and queue

📺 IPTV & Live Streams:
● Load M3U playlists and Xtream Codes accounts
● Paste any HLS (.m3u8) or MPD/DASH link and play instantly
● Adaptive quality for live streams

⚙️ Player Controls:
● Subtitles, including external .srt / .vtt / .ass files
● Audio and subtitle track switching
● Equalizer and audio effects
● Playback speed, aspect ratio and zoom
● Screen lock, Picture-in-Picture and background play
● Cast to TV
● Portrait and landscape viewing

🔒 Privacy Friendly:
● No personal data is collected or stored
● Your videos and music never leave your device — nothing is uploaded
● All links and content are fully controlled by users
● No account or login required
● Works fully offline for videos stored on your device

📱 How to Use:
1️⃣ Open the app to see every video on your device, grouped by folder
2️⃣ Tap any video to play — it resumes where you left off
3️⃣ To play a stream, open the Stream tab and paste an HLS (.m3u8) or MPD link
4️⃣ To load IPTV, open Playlists and add an M3U URL or Xtream Codes login
5️⃣ Use the player controls for subtitles, speed, equalizer and more

⚠️ Disclaimer:
MNet Player does not host, upload, or provide any media content.
The app only plays local files stored on your device and links added by users from publicly available sources.
Users are responsible for ensuring they have the right to access the content they play.
